dict.string: Boredroom uses your microphone only while you hold the talk shortcut, so your assistant can turn what you say into text on this Mac, and in calls and voice notes you start.
Boredroom uses your camera only in calls, when you turn your camera on.
Boredroom asks Finder which files and folders you've selected, and empties the Bin only when you ask and say yes.
Boredroom uploads the files you choose from Documents, and your assistant works on files there only when you ask. Nothing is deleted.
Boredroom uploads the files you choose from your Desktop, and your assistant works on files and saves screenshots there only when you ask.
Boredroom saves the files you download from your dashboard to Downloads, and your assistant works on files there only when you ask. Nothing is deleted.
